{'text': '前《Good Morning America》主持Amy Robach和T.J. Holmes上週宣布結婚，現在他們的前配偶也有自己的消息公布。', 'paragraph_context': 'Former "Good Morning America" hosts Amy Robach and T.J. Holmes announced they got married last week, and now their former spouses have an announcement of their own.'}

{'text': '據《People》雜誌報道，前《Melrose Place》演員Andrew Shue（2010至2023年間與Robach結婚）以及移民律師Marilee Fiebig（同期為Holmes之妻）現已訂婚。', 'paragraph_context': 'Former "Melrose Place" star Andrew Shue, who was married to Robach from 2010 to 2023, and immigration attorney Marilee Fiebig, Holmes\' wife during the same years, are now engaged, according to People.'}

{'text': 'Shue告訴該刊物：「我們心懷感恩，也充滿希望。」', 'paragraph_context': '"We\'re very grateful and hopeful," Shue told the publication.'}

{'text': 'Robach與Holmes於2020年9月首次相遇，當時他們一起主持《GMA3: What You Need to Know》。雖然Robach已婚，對象是Shue，而Holmes的另一半是Fiebig，但據報兩對夫妻在這兩位同事開始約會時，正處於分居或離婚階段。', 'paragraph_context': 'Robach and Holmes first met in September 2020 while working together on "GMA3: What You Need to Know." Although Robach was married to Shue and Holmes to Fiebig, both couples were reportedly either separating or getting divorced when the two co-workers started seeing each other.'}

{'text': '這段婚外情於2022年12月曝光，當時《Daily Mail》刊出照片揭露了二人關係。', 'paragraph_context': 'The affair became public in December 2022, after the Daily Mail published photos revealing the relationship.'}

{'text': 'Holmes隨即向Fiebig提出離婚，但這宗醜聞導致ABC News總裁Kim Godwin在事件曝光後暫時將兩人撤出節目。Godwin於2023年1月將撤換決定改為永久性。', 'paragraph_context': 'Holmes soon filed for divorce from Fiebig, but the scandal led ABC News President Kim Godwin to temporarily remove them from the air after the story broke. Godwin made it permanent in January 2023.'}

{'text': '與此同時，Shue和Fiebig在各自婚姻走向終結的過程中成為朋友，並自然而然地開始約會。', 'paragraph_context': 'Meanwhile, Shue and Fiebig became friends while dealing with the ends of their marriages and actually started dating on their own.'}

{'text': 'Shue告訴《People》：「我也不知道這事是怎麼發生的，但結局是美好的。」', 'paragraph_context': '"I don\'t know how it happened, but there\'s a happy ending," Shue told People.'}

{'text': 'Shue表示，他一直認為家庭是一個人「最重要的項目」，以及「建立一個家，向孩子們展示一段他們能夠看見和體驗到的愛的關係」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Shue said that he\'s always felt a person\'s family is their "most important project," as well as "creating a home and showing [his children] them a loving relationship they can see and experience."'}

{'text': '他說自己「必須接受自己在婚姻失敗中所擔當的角色，承認自己對自己的了解不夠深入，也對關係中真正重要的東西認識不足，無法找到適合我的人，而這一直是一份非凡的禮物」。', 'paragraph_context': 'He said he had "to accept my own part in marriage not working out for me and in not understanding myself well enough and not understanding what matters in a relationship well enough to find the right person for me, and that has been an extraordinary gift."'}

{'text': '不過，聽起來也不該向Shue請教如何找到完美伴侶。', 'paragraph_context': "But it also sounds like one shouldn't ask Shue for tips on finding the perfect partner."}

{'text': '他說：「你不知道怎樣才會遇見適合自己的人，就這樣發生了。你可以說，這純粹是一種奇妙的運氣，讓你最終以一種能讓彼此坦誠相待的方式認識對方。」', 'paragraph_context': '"You don\'t know how you meet the person who\'s right for you," he said. "It just happened. And you can say how it\'s just this kind of freak luck that this is how you ended up getting to know that person in a way that would allow you to reveal yourself and for her to reveal herself."'}
